name: Terminal field-mapper provider-adapter contract
ci_skip: requires a per-run nxd-desktop stdio MCP server with a synthetic mapper-provider injection and a redacted JSON-RPC trace sink. evals/run.py can provision only the supervisor CLI (fixtures/desktop.json) or the semantic HTTP stub (fixtures/mcp.json); neither exposes the nxd-desktop mapper build tools over stdio nor captures their public MCP trace.

checks.check: The generated mapper transform constructs its callable with public make_call and passes it to map_inputs. It imports no provider SDK, field_mapper.transport, field_mapper.ledger, or undocumented proposal attributes. The deterministic closure scan is authoritative.
The captured public nxd-desktop MCP trace contains the mapper build path and no credential material. A missing trace is an evaluator infrastructure failure, never an agent PASS.

The runner capability records setup/provider/agent outcomes separately and cleans per-run state and its server process after success, timeout, or agent termination; this is runner infrastructure, not an agent transcript claim.
